findings.description: The retry now glues the weak question to the most recent earlier user question with no check that it was answered or that the current question refers back to it. The removed code skipped unanswered turns and required reference words.
findings.rationale: Trigger: the user asks an off-topic question that gets no context (NO_CONTEXT_ANSWER), then asks an unrelated standalone weak question such as a new topic. The changed line calls rag.retrieve with the unanswered off-topic question plus the new question, so the model receives context from a turn the code previously excluded. Impact: answers can be grounded in unrelated handbook passages, or the retry can pull in an off-topic question's chunks, which the removed comment explicitly said should not happen.
